items.title: Durable real-browser origin-down regression for the offline recovery path
items.why: S397's origin-confirmed recovery was proven once by hand; no running gate exercises the adapter-online/origin-down case, so a regression back to the reload loop would go unseen (S397 committed [SIL] item).
items.userOutcome: Conversion protection: a visitor whose network is up but our origin is down sees a stable offline page and returns automatically once the origin answers, instead of a reload loop.
items.recipe: Extend tests/service-worker-install.spec.js: after activation, route origin traffic (including service-worker fetches) to abort, navigate to an uncached public route, assert offline fallback renders and does not reload; restore routing, trigger retry, assert exactly one recovery to the requested page. Runs in the existing e2e.yml and verify:local core tier.
items.acceptance: New test passes against local preview; fails when error-pages.js reverts to unconditional reload (mutation check); existing install test still passes.
items.stageRationale: Supported release: protect a just-shipped reliability fix with a running gate.
